draw.title: Draw
draw.body:
Each pick starts with a draw: three club-seasons from your era, shown as [[cutting|cuttings]]. You pick one player from one of them.

You get two [[redraw|redraws]] per draft.

cutting.title: Cutting
cutting.body: One club-season from the archive, with the players it can offer for the slot you are filling, in shirt order. Ratings stay hidden until kick-off, so knowing the squad is the edge.

redraw.title: Redraw
redraw.body: Throws all three cuttings back and draws again. Two per draft, and they do not come back.

era.title: Era
era.body: The seasons your draw comes from. A narrow era means players who might have played together; a wide one means more choice and a bigger [[cohesion]] cost when the decades clash.

job.title: Job
job.body:
What a player is asked to do in his position: a blocker or a passing centre-back, a poacher or a link forward. Each job weights his contribution to attack, defence, build-up, pressing and creativity.

A job comes with a [[brief]].

brief.title: Brief
brief.body:
How far forward a player is asked to play his [[job]].

Hold keeps position and covers behind the ball. Link connects both ends without committing to either. Push commits forward for more threat and less cover.

cohesion.title: Cohesion
cohesion.body:
How well the eleven know this system. Coherent set-ups, players in their natural positions and an XI from close seasons raise it; extreme dials, wandering positions and a squad spanning decades lower it.

It also remembers: every season kept in the same shape and identity adds a little (up to +8), and changing either costs −4 for the season of the change. Within a season it [[settling|settles]] too.

Low cohesion makes results streaky and gates the bonus an [[identity]] gives.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body:
The style the engine recognises in your dials: a gegenpress, possession control, a low-block counter, wing play, direct and vertical, or park the bus. A well-drilled identity earns a bonus in the simulation.

A committed set-up that matches none of them still earns a smaller bonus. Sitting on the fence with every dial near the middle is the one thing that is punished.

blank-slate.title: Blank slate
blank-slate.body: Every dial at neutral and no [[identity]] bonus. A starting point for building your own system, not a system in itself.

mentality.title: Mentality
mentality.body: The master dial. Scales risk and reward across every other instruction, from Contain to All-out.

tempo.title: Tempo
tempo.body: How quickly the ball moves once you have it. Slow controls the game; fast tries to overwhelm a defence before it can set.

directness.title: Directness
directness.body: Short passing builds through the thirds and keeps the ball; direct passing skips the midfield battle to win territory fast.

width.title: Width
width.body: How far the team stretches the pitch. Wide play opens space in the middle; narrow play packs the half-spaces for combinations.

focus.title: Passing focus
focus.body: Where the team looks to progress the ball: combinations through the middle, or overloads down the flanks.

counter.title: Counter-attacking
counter.body: How eagerly the team breaks the instant it wins the ball, rather than resetting its shape first. Devastating in transition, costly when it gives the ball away cheaply.

crossing.title: Crossing
crossing.body: How often wide players deliver early rather than cut inside. Wasted without real [[width]] and someone to attack the ball.

gk-distribution.title: Keeper distribution
gk-distribution.body: Whether the keeper plays out short under pressure or goes long to bypass the press and fight for the second ball.

press.title: Pressing
press.body: How aggressively the team hunts the ball and how high up the pitch it starts. A high press invites risk in behind, especially with a high [[line|defensive line]].

line.title: Defensive line
line.body: Where the back line holds. A high line squeezes the space the [[press]] works in but is exposed to balls in behind; a deep block cedes territory on purpose.

tackling.title: Tackling
tackling.body: Aggressive tackling wins more duels and risks fouls, cards and playing a man short.

marking.title: Marking
marking.body: Zonal defends space; man-to-man defends the opponent. Man-to-man is more secure one-on-one and more exploitable when a player is dragged out of position.

offside-trap.title: Offside trap
offside-trap.body: A high-risk, high-reward step-up. A real edge with a fast, disciplined back line playing a high [[line]]; a liability otherwise.

discipline.title: Discipline
discipline.body: Rigid keeps players tight to their jobs; loose lets them drift and swap positions more freely.

strengths.title: Strengths
strengths.body: Six team qualities the simulation uses: attack, creativity, build-up, press, defence and physical. The tick on each bar is the average of the other nineteen clubs, so you can see where you are ahead.

career-code.title: Career code
career-code.body: Every career comes from one seed. Share the code and someone else can start the same draft and see whether they build a better XI.

attacking-freedom.title: Attacking freedom
attacking-freedom.body: How far a player may drift from his zone to combine and join attacks. More freedom adds threat and costs defensive shape.

defensive-discipline.title: Defensive discipline
defensive-discipline.body: How rigorously a player tracks his runner and holds his line instead of being drawn out of position. Stricter is safer and less creative.

stat-bands.title: Stat bands
stat-bands.body: Every stat shows as one of five bands, from weak to elite, and the overall rating stays hidden until kick-off. Knowing the player is the edge; reading a number is not.

settling.title: Settling
settling.body:
Cohesion for the next match from the matches already played this season in the same system: the shape, the seven identity dials and the discipline. The first match of a season, or the first after a change, costs −3; the next two −2 and −1; from the seventh match in a row it pays +3.

Swapping players and moving the other dials do not count as a change.
